thread:
sam: FYI starting a small schema migration for payments.v2 tonight at 02:00 UTC. planning a pinned rollout to 1.12.3, canary on 5% traffic first. :hourglass:

dana: ack. what's the backfill plan? any long-lived locks expected? :eyes:

sam: backfill is the usual txn_count -> aggregate_count async job. will run with rate cap and low batch size. no exclusive table locks expected, but there's a short index creation on payments.tmp_index that uses CONCURRENTLY.

mike: suggest abort criteria: if >30s row lock wait on primary or replication lag > 90s, we abort and pin previous model. also keep the DB ops path on standby for fast rollback.

jess: adding release notes link: https://go/internal/release-notes/1.12.3 (draft). includes migration notes and ops checklist.

sam: deploybot, schedule canary at 02:00 UTC, holdpoint at 02:20 UTC for manual check.

deploybot: @sam scheduled canary for 2026-06-01T02:00:00Z. holdpoint alarm set for +20m. canary target: 5% of traffic. automated rollback threshold: error rate > 2% or latency p95 increase > 200ms.

dana: quick backup/restore tick? full logical dump before migration?

sam: we'll snapshot the replica using pg_basebackup and also export the affected tables with `pg_dump -t payments --schema-only` as a quick restore artifact.

mike: put this in the migration runbook snippet for oncall:```
If locks observed:
  - run `SELECT pid, query, state, wait_event_type FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event IS NOT NULL;`
  - identify session with most blocking time and `pg_terminate_backend(pid)` if safe
  - escalate to DBA if > 3 blocked sessions
```

sam: tagging @dana on rollback steps: we will pin the deployment to 1.12.2 and re-route traffic to the pre-canary pool. also a manual DB migration rollback patch is prepared (DDL is idempotent).

dana: noted. also please add a DB throttle on the backfill job: rate cap 50 rows/s and `sleep(0.2)` between batches.

sam: done. config snippet:```yaml
backfill:
  enabled: true
  rate_limit_rps: 50
  batch_size: 500
  inter_batch_sleep_ms: 200
```

jess: will update release notes with rollback matrix and add the KIM for Dedicated customers.

mike: canary runbook: monitor `pg_stat_activity` and `replication_lag_seconds`, watch queued connections > 10 for >5m -> abort. also check deploybot canary metrics in console.

sam: during the holdpoint I'll run a quick smoke: checkout 10 payments, run sample reads/writes, and confirm latency. if all green we proceed to 50% burst window then 100%.

deploybot: canary started (id: cb-310987). metrics stream: https://console/internal/metrics/cb-310987

dana: :thumbsup: I'm on watch for the 02:20 holdpoint. slack alert channel already subscribed.

sam: thanks. tagging this thread for post-mortem notes if anything unusual. final preflight checklist in runbook updated.

mike: small ask — add an escape hatch command in ops-runbook: `/deploy rollback payments 1.12.2 --force`

sam: adding it now.

jess: merged release notes and added links to runbook and rollback commands. will notify support.

deploybot: canary completed: 5% traffic ran for 20m, error rate 0.3%, p95 latency +40ms. proceeding to staged rollout per policy.

dana: great. standing by for any lock noise.

sam: closing thread, will post short post-deploy note in #release-summary after rollout completes. :white_check_mark:
